MonitorModelV1.description: The Harness model the user chose for investigations. Credentials stay in the provider worker; this request never carries a key.

provider_options.description: Provider-native options, namespaced by the selected provider id.

oneOf.description: No reasoning at all; honoured only where the model advertises `supports_thinking_off` (elsewhere the provider falls back to its own lowest setting, or omits the parameter, and warns).

_caller_worker_id.description: Stamped by the engine on every invocation; callers omit it. Listed so the closed schema still accepts the engine's metadata.

code_repository.description: Absolute path of the codebase directory the investigation reads and runs in (normally the iii workers repository, checked out on the monitor's host); absent means no code access.

daily_cost_cap_usd.description: US dollars of known investigation cost per UTC day after which no automatic analysis starts an investigation until the next day; absent means no cap.
